objective: Evaluate the effectiveness of the inventive device in reducing screw loosening rate in dental implants after 6 months of use
dependent_variables: screw loosening rate in dental implants after 6 months of use
procedure: Recruit 100 participants with a history of dental implant placement
Randomly assign participants to either the inventive device group or the standard interface group
Place dental implants with either the inventive device or the standard interface
Monitor and record screw loosening rates for 6 months
Conduct follow-up appointments to ensure proper implant integration and address any complications
expected_result: A 30% reduction in screw loosening rate in the inventive device group compared to the standard interface group
falsification_condition: If the inventive device does not show a statistically significant reduction in screw loosening rate compared to the standard interface, or if the reduction is less than 20%
sample_requirements: 100 participants with a history of dental implant placement, aged 18-75, with a minimum of 2 years of implant placement experience
safety_constraints: Ensure proper implant placement and integration, monitor for any signs of implant failure or complications
estimated_cost: $500,000 (including participant recruitment, implant placement, follow-up appointments, and data analysis)
estimated_duration: 12 months (including participant recruitment, implant placement, follow-up appointments, and data analysis)
information_gain: Understanding the effectiveness of the inventive device in reducing screw loosening rate in dental implants, and its potential to improve implant longevity and patient outcomes
